top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings since this morning's edition
paragraphs: All 87 Form 99 and Request for Additional Information filings the Federal Election Commission indexed from October 3 through now were already covered in earlier editions, most of them in this morning's. Nothing new has surfaced since.

sections.headline: Nothing new to report
paragraphs: No Requests for Additional Information or Form 99 correspondence appeared that hadn't already been listed in a prior edition. A keyword scan flagged four letters, but the only hit in each was the standard federal warning about penalties for fraudulent statements, not an allegation, and all four were already covered.

footer.coverage_window: FEC filings received October 3, 2026 through the time of this run on October 6, 2026, Pacific time.
